The AgentTeams manager image: a cachyos base composing the
agentteams-manager layer — the openclaw gateway runtime (built from
the pinned upstream source commit because the matrix channel
extension is not in the npm openclaw package) with the agt REST
client and mc. The controller spawns this image for the default
Manager CR through the host rootless podman socket; the manager
joins the charly network and reaches the controller's in-container
services by the controller container's DNS name. Rootless: the
service runs as the image user (uid 1000).

## Composition

This box composes:

- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-supervisord:v2026.271.1817`
- `@github.com/opencharly/pod-agentteams-manager:v2026.274.0759`
